title: 第977章 黑球第976章 幸运的养魂液
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
“幸运，这养魂液能助你突破？”
林潜问道。
“呜呜！”
幸运重重点头。
“好，那便予你！”
林潜不再迟疑，指尖轻挑，拨开玉瓶瓶塞。
顿时一股一股清冽纯净的奇异香气四散弥漫，充盈整片山谷。
香气入鼻，林潜自身的灵魂都微微震颤，泛起阵阵酥麻舒适之感，心底不由自主生出一股想要尽数吸纳、滋养己身的冲动。
他强行压下灵魂深处的躁动，凝神看向身前的幸运。
此刻的幸运早已瞪圆了漆黑的小眼睛，死死盯着林潜掌心的寒玉瓶，眼底充斥着极致的渴望与迫不及待，周身黑雾都因情绪波动微微起伏。
“来吧！”
林潜将养魂液递给了幸运。
幸运身形一闪，轻盈飞掠至林潜掌心，爪子抓住玉瓶，尖尖的口器探入瓶中，迫不及待地开始吸纳瓶内珍贵的养魂液。
养魂液顺着它的口器汇入体内，瞬间化作一缕缕温润澄澈的能量，流转四肢百骸，最终尽数汇聚于脑海。
幸运的灵魂，仿佛久旱逢甘霖，疯狂吞噬着这股能量。
周身原本盘踞的漆黑诡异纹路，不再散发阴冷煞气，反倒在这股能量的冲刷下缓缓流转、蜕变，暗沉的墨色逐渐褪去，透出一层深邃透亮的幽光。
伴随着幸运灵魂壮大，山谷之中的雾气也开始出现变化。
原本笼罩山谷、压抑死寂的灰黑阴煞雾气，仿佛受到无形牵引，朝着石台中心的幸运飞速聚拢。
四处飘散的戾气、厄运残留之力，皆被它的身躯吸收。
原本阴冷死寂的山谷，浊气飞速消退。

林潜静立一旁，目光沉沉注视，心中暗暗惊叹养魂液的逆天功效。
寻常滋养灵魂之物，起效缓慢，需日积月累方能初见成效，可这一瓶养魂液，却以肉眼可见的速度增强幸运的灵魂强度。
时光缓缓流逝，不过短短半个时辰。
当最后一滴养魂液被彻底被幸运吸纳炼化的刹那！
嗡——
一道无形无质的涟漪从幸运头颅骤然炸开，席卷整座山谷！
幸运的灵魂突破了瓶颈。
“呜呜……呜呜……”
幸运仰头发出清脆欢快的低鸣，声声雀跃，如同重获新生，通体舒畅无比。
只见它双翅猛然一振，娇小的身形化作一道灵动黑影，在半空急速盘旋穿梭，圈圈残影叠现，清脆的呜呜鸣叫声不断回荡在幽谷之间，宣泄着喜悦。
可仅仅十来息后，幸运骤然收敛姿态，灵动的虫目转头望向下方的林潜，眼底满是亲昵与依赖。
随即身形一掠，稳稳落回石台之上。
下一瞬！
轰！
一道耀眼至极的炽白光芒骤然从它体内爆发而出，如同山间骤然升起的烈日，光辉四射，夺目刺眼，将整座幽谷映照得亮如白昼。
哪怕是林潜，也被这突如其来的璀璨强光晃得微微眯起双眼。
content_en:
"Luckily, can this soul nourishing liquid help you break through?"
Lin Qian asked.
"Woo!"
Lucky nodded heavily.
"Okay, I'll give it to you then!"
Lin Qian no longer hesitated, and opened the cork of the jade bottle with his fingertips.
Suddenly, a clear and pure strange aroma spread in all directions, filling the entire valley.
As soon as the aroma entered his nose, Lin Qian's own soul trembled slightly, feeling numb and comfortable, and he couldn't help but feel an urge to absorb and nourish his body.
He forced down the restlessness deep in his soul and looked at the luck in front of him with concentration.
At this moment, Lucky had already widened his small dark eyes, staring intently at the cold jade bottle in Lin Qian's palm. His eyes were filled with extreme desire and impatience, and the black fog around him undulated slightly due to emotional fluctuations.
"Come on!"
Lin Qian handed the soul nourishing liquid to Lucky.
Lucky's figure flashed and flew lightly into Lin Qian's palm. He grabbed the jade bottle with his talons, inserted his pointed mouthparts into the bottle, and eagerly began to absorb the precious soul-nourishing liquid in the bottle.
The soul-nourishing liquid flowed into the body along its mouthparts, and instantly turned into wisps of warm and clear energy, flowing through the limbs and bones, and finally gathered in the mind.
Lucky souls, as if they were suddenly greeted by rain after a long drought, crazily devoured this energy.
The dark and strange lines that were originally entrenched around the body no longer exude a cold and evil aura. Instead, they slowly flow and transform under the wash of this energy. The dark ink color gradually fades, revealing a deep and translucent light.
As the lucky soul grew stronger, the fog in the valley also began to change.
The gray-black mist that originally shrouded the valley and suppressed the deathly silence seemed to be drawn by invisible forces and quickly gathered towards the luck in the center of the stone platform.
The violent energy and residual power of misfortune floating around were all absorbed by its body.
The turbid air in the originally cold and dead valley quickly subsided.
Lin Qian stood aside quietly, watching with deep eyes, secretly marveling at the heaven-defying effect of the soul nourishing liquid.
Ordinary soul-nourishing substances are slow to take effect and require accumulation over time to achieve initial results. However, this bottle of soul-nourishing liquid can enhance the strength of lucky souls at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Time passed slowly, only half an hour.
The moment when the last drop of soul nourishing liquid is completely absorbed and refined by luck!
Buzz——
An invisible ripple suddenly exploded from Lucky's head, sweeping across the entire valley!
Lucky souls break through the bottleneck.
"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooh
Lucky raised his head and let out a crisp and cheerful low cry, his voice jumping for joy, as if he had been reborn, and his whole body felt extremely comfortable.
I saw its wings suddenly fluttering, and its petite body turned into a smart black shadow, circling rapidly in mid-air. Afterimages appeared in circles, and its crisp whining sounds continued to echo in the valley, venting its joy.
But after only ten breaths, Lucky suddenly restrained his posture, and his agile insect eyes turned to look at Lin Qian below, his eyes full of intimacy and dependence.
Immediately, his body swept away and fell steadily back to the stone platform.
The next moment!
boom!
A dazzling white light suddenly burst out from its body, like the scorching sun rising suddenly in the mountains. It was radiant and dazzling, illuminating the entire valley as bright as day.
Even Lin Qian narrowed his eyes slightly due to the sudden bright light.
